name: omnisend
label: Omnisend
description: All-in-one ecommerce marketing platform for email, SMS, and push notification campaigns with powerful automation and segmentation.

token.label: API Key
token.description:
To obtain your Omnisend API key:
1. Log in to your [Omnisend account](https://app.omnisend.com).
2. Go to **Store settings → Integrations & API → API Keys**.
3. Click **Create API Key**, give it a name.
4. Copy the generated key and paste it here.

get_contact.label: Get Contact
get_contact.description: Retrieve a contact by their contact ID.

list_contacts.label: List Contacts
list_contacts.description: Retrieve a paginated list of contacts from Omnisend.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of contacts to skip for pagination.

send_customer_event.label: Send Customer Event
send_customer_event.description: Send a customer event to Omnisend. Events track customer behavior and trigger automations (e.g. welcome emails, abandoned cart reminders). Use predefined events or create custom ones.

email.label: Contact Email
email.description: Email address of the contact to send the event for.

eventName.label: Event Name
eventName.description: The name of the event. Use predefined names (e.g. "added product to cart", "placed order") or a custom event name.

properties.label: Event Properties
properties.description: Custom key-value properties to include with the event (e.g. {"orderId": "12345", "totalPrice": 99.99}).

list_campaigns.label: List Campaigns
list_campaigns.description: Retrieve a list of email campaigns.

offset.label: Offset
offset.description: Number of campaigns to skip for pagination.
